claim_definitions.prescribed_initial_layout: The complete video begins in the prescribed reset layout, with the magnifier resting on the table.
claim_definitions.picked_up_by_handle: The robot picks the magnifier up by its handle using an ordinary gripper grasp.
claim_definitions.held_only_by_gripper: Throughout the scored interval, only the gripper supports the tool at its handle; the glass/frame are not propped against a camera, robot link, table or other object.
claim_definitions.tool_and_target_intact: The tool and printed target remain intact and unmodified, and the target stays fixed throughout the trial.
claim_definitions.ordinary_physics_and_camera: The recorded trial uses ordinary robot contact, no object attachment/teleport/applied object force, and unchanged native camera settings without digital crop, zoom or image replacement.
claim_definitions.continuous_hold_visible: The video shows an uninterrupted handle grasp and at least 20 mm whole-tool table clearance throughout the scored three-second interval, with no visible interruption.
